articles.title: Bitcoin miners were hijacked and their BTC rewards redirected to an attacker
articles.snippet: Luxor said just over a dozen customers were affected and will be reimbursed after their machines were redirected to another mining pool.

articles.title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
articles.snippet: Researchers say attackers compromised scripts delivered through Optimizely, exposing visitors to malware designed to replace crypto wallet addresses and steal payment card details.

articles.title: Luxor CEO warns of AI ‘dark forest’ following Bitcoin miner hijack
articles.snippet: Attackers redirected customers’ Bitcoin mining power through Luxor’s Commander platform over the weekend, prompting its CEO to issue a warning to crypto businesses.

articles.title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says
articles.snippet: Luxor said hackers redirected hashrate from just over a dozen client accounts through its Commander tool, and its CEO blamed a “sophisticated AI-enabled vector.”
